reason: Free listing costs me nothing so I might let them load my flyers, but I wouldn't pay a cent until I see real users here. I've paid for promo apps that brought nobody.
objection: How many people actually use this app here? A new app in one city with no audience is the same story I've already paid for once.
would_change_my_mind: A published monthly active user count well past 2,000 in my city, and a nearby club telling me the app actually brought people through the door.
